syllabus_metadata.title: Geography Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education
syllabus_metadata.subject: Geography

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the structure of the Earth
competences.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the origin and the structure of the Earth and Earth systems

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explain the concept and scope of Geography (branches, importance and relationship with other disciplines)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: In manageable groups students brainstorm on the meaning, branches and importance of Geography, and relationship between Geography and other disciplines
Field Observation: Guide students to observe landforms, vegetations and human activities to support the concept of geography and summarise their importance in relationship to other disciplines
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Basic concepts of Geography are clearly explained
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Relevant books, charts, and ICT simulation tools on the concept of Geography

learning_activities.activity: (b) Describe the Earth (origin, shape, size, position and movements of the earth in the solar system, and parallels and meridians)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm and present about the origin, shape, size, position and movements of the earth in the solar system, and parallels and meridians
Field Observation: Guide students to observe the Earth's surface and identify some of the components of the solar system
Project work: Group students to design a model on the components of the solar system (size, shape, distance, position), and then present in class
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Relevant books, globe, picture of solar system, relevant ICT simulation tools and models on the planet earth

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the structure of the Earth
competences.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate an understanding of the major features of the Earth surface

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe major features of the Earth's surface (continents, oceans, major relief features, large inland water bodies and vegetation zones)
teaching_learning_methods: Questions & Answers: Guide students to mention landforms available in their surroundings

Field observation: Guide students to visit the nearby landforms, vegetation and water bodies available in their communities to examine the formation, distribution and their importance to the communities
Group Discussion: Guide students to discuss the size and distribution of continents, then present in the class
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The major features of the Earth are correctly described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Environment, relevant books, relief maps, globe/models, and relevant ICT simulation tools
